CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2666 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 0dda6260a8261233bb435442e52c219f3117a747. Bus nonce: 5a187767a51345f5f5a1d2074722afe4. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 0dda6260a8261233bb435442e52c219f3117a747`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 0dda6260a8261233bb435442e52c219f3117a747` or `Fix review: blocked 0dda6260a8261233bb435442e52c219f3117a747 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 5a187767a51345f5f5a1d2074722afe4`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `0dda6260a8261233bb435442e52c219f3117a747` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2666 0dda6260a8261233bb435442e52c219f3117a747") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2666-5a187767`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2666, R10-FLY-INERT-LOAD-TIME (lane FLY, size S, instrument), the barrier for audit class I2, built by the root-cause seat beside #2662. Branch fix/r10-rca-inert-closure-recording, head 0dda6260a8261233bb435442e52c219f3117a747. The code head is e9d169b7; 0dda6260 adds only the delivery row. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Your ev/ MUST contain ev/HEAD.txt holding the full 40-hex head, or the relay refuses the verdict.

Claim: a closures recording carries an inert_reads split decided by the recording tree's INERT list. A later INERT_EXCEPT edit voids that split, but `merge` and `check` trusted it, so `check` passed vacuously (#2662's probe d5b053e then went UNDER-SCOPED: 32 min of red FULL closures). The barrier:
- tests/closure.py `_load_recording` re-splits each recording's inert_reads under the loading tree's INERT list, for merge and check;
- tools/pr/ci_predict.py `left_inert` predicts UNDER-SCOPED statically when a diff edits tests/closure.py and a committed inert_reads file has left INERT while its script's closure omits it (prepr step 6d, body_push);
- the RCA doc dev/audit/rca/R10-RCA-INERT-CLOSURE-RECORDING.md and a bugclasses.json I2 entry.

Verify adversarially, with the finder's harness:
(1) Three-dot diff: only the five files above, plus fixtures/tests for them and dev/programme/delivery/2666.md.
(2) Reproduce instance 3 yourself. At d5b053e (fetch it), run `check` over the d0ff8268b-era recording (artifact 12493224545, or rebuild an equivalent fixture recording) with main's closure.py: rc 0, vacuous. Then with this PR's closure.py: rc 1, UNDER-SCOPED on u5's run_part.py and unitcheck.py under tests/harness_headers.py. `ci_predict.py` at the head predicts the same 2. Never run a full derive_closures.sh off Linux; `--single` on a Python script is allowed.
(3) Null controls: an INERT edit whose recordings are fresh passes check and predicts nothing; a recording whose inert_reads files are all still INERT is unchanged by the re-split; and the 8 live inert_reads entries the RCA says are not under-scoped today produce no false UNDER-SCOPED on main's committed closures.json.
(4) Mutants: drop the re-split in _load_recording, drop left_inert's closure-omits test, and make left_inert ignore diffs that edit tests/closure.py. Each must go red.
(5) The figures: the cost numbers (7.1 ms per recording, 8.1 ms per predictor run, 28 INERT_EXCEPT edits, 82 non-merge commits) and the process-state (c) claim. Re-derive what you can and mark the rest not re-derived under ## Evidence. Run `python3 tools/audit/fold_ledger.py check` and record its violation count.
(6) `git merge-tree --write-tree` against origin/main is clean. Read CI with one bulk check-runs call. No commit carries a footer. Record the scoped-gate MODE line.
Rules: PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; spare the GitHub API; no Claude footers.
